preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 10**9 for x in A)
preconditions.description: All elements in the input array A are integers between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The length of the input array A is between 3 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= len(A) for i in range(1, len(A) + 1))
preconditions.description: Indices in the problem statement (1-based) are valid for the array A.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(B) == len(A) and len(C) == len(A) and sorted(B) == sorted(A) and sorted(C) == sorted(A))
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'NO', stdout must contain only 'NO'. If 'YES', stdout must contain two permutations B and C of A, each of length N.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(not (1 <= i <= j <= len(A) and (i, j) != (1, len(A)) and sorted(B[i-1:j]) == sorted(C[i-1:j])) for i in range(1, len(A) + 1) for j in range(i, len(A) + 1))
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', the permutations B and C must satisfy that no subarray B[i:j] (1 ≤ i ≤ j ≤ N, (i,j) ≠ (1,N)) is a permutation of the corresponding subarray C[i:j].

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and any(sorted(B) == sorted(A) and sorted(C) == sorted(A) for B, C in permutations(A, 2)))
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', there must exist at least one pair of permutations B and C of A that satisfy the condition in Q2.
